VFT-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProfileCard component and its CSS. It has a bordered container with a thin border, a title, a subtitle, and a skeleton variant with two shimmer bars (one full-width, one shorter at about 60% width). Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist for border-width, colors, spacing, sizes). Include the CSS file.
VFT-01.output:
Written to `src/components/ProfileCard/ProfileCard.css`. Key decisions:

- All `@keyframes skeleton-shimmer` is declared **inside** `@layer components` (constraint 1).
- Every value uses `--shelf-*` tokens — no raw colors, sizes, or durations (constraint 2).
- No `margin` on the container; only `margin-block-start` on the second skeleton bar as a sibling-spacing reset, not self-centering (constraint 3).
- Only `opacity` is animated (constraint 5); `transform` is available but not needed here.
- Class selectors are kebab-case: `.profile-card`, `.profile-card-title`, `.profile-card-subtitle`, `.profile-card-skeleton-bar` (constraint 8).
- The two shimmer bars are distinguished by the adjacent sibling selector (`+ .profile-card-skeleton-bar`) to set the 60% width on the second bar, keeping the first full-width.

<promise>COMPLETE</promise>
